grounded.summary: The run verdict is fail. Three results passed automatically: the mobile landing page showed no horizontal overflow, Lighthouse mobile performance scored 100 against a minimum of 90, and the site responded with HTTP 200. The blocking contact form check failed: the form was found and submitted, but no request reached the test sink, no receipt was recorded, and the expected success text was not seen. The accessibility criterion was not measured by any tool and awaits an authorized human reviewer. The work is not fully verified.

explanations.explanation: At a 390x844 viewport the page returned HTTP 200 and scroll_width (390) equaled viewport_width (390), so there was no horizontal overflow. No required visible selectors were specified, so none were checked.

The form and all three expected fields were found (form_found true, fields_missing empty), but after submission there were no requests to the test sink (sink_requests empty), no receipts in the database (sink_receipts_in_db 0), and the success text 'Thank you' was not seen. No prohibited or unrelated blocked requests were recorded, so the submission was not blocked by egress rules. The measurements show the form did not deliver data to the test endpoint, but they do not show why (for example a missing or incorrect form action, a JavaScript error, a disabled submit button, or client-side validation).
explanations.remediation: Check that the form's submit handler or action actually sends a POST to the configured test endpoint. Verify that button[type=submit] triggers submission, that no JavaScript console errors or client-side validation prevent it, and that the form's action URL is correct. After a successful submission, show the text 'Thank you'. Then rerun the verification.

explanations.explanation: No tool measured this criterion. It is unresolved and awaits an authorized human reviewer, who would check keyboard navigation, text alternatives, color contrast, form labels and heading structure. The instructions also note that the accessibility standard is not yet defined in the requirements.
explanations.remediation: Because this criterion has not been evaluated, there is no specific fix to give. The buyer should define the accessibility standard so a reviewer can assess it.
explanations.uncertainty: Not verifiable by the automated tools; it remains unresolved until an authorized human reviewer records a decision.

explanations.explanation: One mobile Lighthouse run with simulated throttling scored 100, above the minimum of 90. No adaptive retry was needed.
The path / returned HTTP 200 with no redirects in 57 ms. The checked URL was http://127.0.0.1:8020/landing-page-broken/, and HTTPS was not required for this check.

The form was found and all fields were filled with no missing fields. The submission reached the test sink, which returned status 201, and one receipt was recorded in the database. The success text 'Thank you' was displayed, and there were no prohibited requests or unrelated blocked requests.

No tool measured this criterion; it is unresolved and awaits an authorized human reviewer. explanations.remediation: No fix can be specified until a reviewer assesses the page. The buyer should define the accessibility standard (for example WCAG 2.1 AA). In the meantime the provider can self-check keyboard navigation, alt text on images, color contrast, labels on form fields and heading order.
